learning_objective: 🎯 Understand what management is, its core features, and why it is the essential driving force behind the success of any organization!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Management is the process of getting things done with the aim of achieving goals effectively (doing the right task on time) and efficiently (doing it with minimum cost).
Management is goal-oriented, pervasive (needed everywhere), multidimensional (manages work, people, and operations), continuous, and a dynamic group activity.
Organizations have Top Level (CEOs setting goals), Middle Level (Managers executing plans), and Supervisory/Operational Level (Foremen directly overseeing workers).
Management is an Art (requires personal skills/creativity), a Science (based on systematic knowledge/principles), and a developing Profession.
Coordination isn't a separate function; it's the invisible thread that binds Planning, Organising, Staffing, Directing, and Controlling together to ensure harmony.

fun_activity.title: 🍕 The Pizza Shop Manager
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you are running a pizza shop! You need effectiveness (delivering the pizza in 30 mins) AND efficiency (using ingredients without wasting them). Write down 3 ways you can improve efficiency in your kitchen!

exam_tips: 📌 Always clearly differentiate between Effectiveness (focuses on end results and time) and Efficiency (focuses on cost-benefit analysis).
📌 In case studies, if a manager achieves the target but at a higher cost, they are effective but NOT efficient.
📌 Remember that coordination is referred to as the 'essence' of management, not just a function.
quick_recap: ⭐ Management is a continuous and dynamic process that adapts to the changing environment.
⭐ Top management focuses on long-term planning, while operational management focuses on daily tasks.
⭐ Without coordination, individual efforts will go in different directions, leading to chaos.
